rootCause.exact: The reviewed Phase3 bootstrap creates /opt/ynx/leases/finance but P0-267/P0-268 cleanup proves that parent legitimately persists after control-file deletion. The parent-exists check fails before deploy executor invocation.

requiredCentralAction: Fail closed and atomically release P0-270 as nonreusable. A source-only successor must preserve an existing signed finance lease parent when its exact tuple is fresh-bound, create only the lease-specific child controls, and retain the same no-replace/identity cleanup rules.
